page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations, with a PassMark CPU score of 36,838.07 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 13,470.0. However, it exhibits strong memory performance, achieving a PassMark memory score of 2,789.6, which is in the top 25% tier. In terms of specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation for small language models (135M parameters) at 316.66 tokens per second, while maintaining average speeds of 19.1 tokens per second for medium-sized 7B models.

The lack of local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for heavy database logging or hardware-accelerated deep learning. However, the dedicated Intel Xeon processor with AVX-512 and cryptography extensions (AES, SHA_NI) offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with the KVM hypervisor, this instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators but provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Benchmark results indicate average multi-core CPU performance alongside strong memory performance, highlighted by a PassMark memory score in the top 25% tier. The processor supports advanced vector and cryptographic instructions, including AVX-512 and AES. This resource profile is highly suited for compute-intensive workloads such as software compilation, static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, and CPU-based machine learning inference where high memory-to-CPU ratios are not required.
